name: TIC 167201446

text.card: A red giant 1,230 parsecs away, 17 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded by TESS, give 0.84 solar masses and 17.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,419 K at its surface.
